text:
maya: Quick sync — proposing a cohort-based rollout + rollback SLA for next quarter's model migrations. Want minimal customer friction and clear gates. High-level proposal below, pls chime in.

tom: 👍 from eng. My initial plan: canary 1% -> 10% -> 50% over 48h windows. Auto-rollback if p95 latency increases >20% OR error rate >2% sustained for 30m. Manual hold if human-quality signals dip.

ravi: Infra note: we need a capacity bump plan for dedicated pools (expect ~50% TPU/GPU utilization increase during 50% cohort). Hardware buckets matter — A100 vs H100 runtime differences will affect latency baselines. We should precompute compatible quantized variants for fallback.

olivia: From CS: customers will ask for a pin/opt-out. Recommend offering a 6-month pin option for enterprise contracts + a documented exception workflow. Also need comm templates for migration windows and known risk profile.

jen: Sales asks: propose migration credits for customers who move within 30 days of opt-in. Also flag top-5 enterprise accounts for concierge migration; they need a >72h notice window.

maya: For benchmarks gating, propose a combined gating ruleset: perf (latency/error), quality (eval suite), and safety/regression checks. We need concrete thresholds — thinking: no more than 1% drop on our normalized quality metric and human-preference >=55% in A/B tests. Thoughts?

tom: Concrete gating snippet (suggested):
```
GATE: new_model_pass = (delta_normalized_quality >= -1%) AND (human_pref >= 55) AND (p95_latency <= baseline * 1.20) AND (error_rate <= 2%)
If new_model_pass == false -> block rollout / require manual override
```
This should be enforced by CI that runs the canary evaluation harness.

olivia: Also add safety checks: classifier drift, hallucination signal increase, and prompt-triggered guardrail failures. If any safety metric worsens >0.1% absolute, hold rollout and open incident.

ravi: Rollback mechanics: automatic fallback to previous pinned model + create ticket to ops with logs and sample traces. Routing policy prototype: `prefer_stable -> canary -> experimental`. Need oncall playbook update.

maya: Deprecation & migration timeline proposal: announce deprecation 90 days before retirement for public models by default. Offer 180-day enterprise grace for pinned exceptions. Exceptions require sales + legal signoff and a recorded JIRA.

jen: We should make migration incentives explicit in renewal conversations. I'll draft a short blurb: credits + dedicated migration window + SLA extension for early movers.

olivia: Comms checklist: customer notice, migration guide, opt-out link, rollback FAQ, and a recovery contact (concierge). I can draft templates.

tom: Monitoring: add eval hooks that run every deployment using a holdout prompt set. If degraded, send to #eng-oncall and pause rollout pipeline automatically. Metrics: human_pref, automated_nli_score, safety_fp_rate, p95_latency.

maya: A few edge items: 1) Pin exceptions must be visible in the console with TTL and owner. 2) We need a migration heatmap to prioritize customers by risk & upgrade friction. 3) Rollouts should allow backoff windows shorter than full rollback when minor regressions observed.

ravi: Implementation note — we can store pin metadata in catalog entries: `pin_owner`, `pin_expires`, `pin_reason`. Console will need a filter for pinned models.

maya: OK action items: tom -> write gating policy + CI hook; ravi -> capacity + playbook updates; olivia -> comm templates + exception form; jen -> list enterprise customers and migration credits plan. Sync Fri 11am. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
